definition: Date of the bibliographic export download.
missing_rule: Preserve historical values; unknown new dates remain missing.
coding_rule: Keep separate from publication batch and coding date.

definition: Permanent report identifier.
missing_rule: Required.
coding_rule: Reuse registry identity including reserved historical aliases; never assign manually.

definition: Stable letter identifying a quantitative sample within a report.
missing_rule: Not extracted for review-only papers.
coding_rule: Assign only after identifying eligible samples; publication Study 2 may receive a.

definition: Permanent identifier for a quantitative matrix.
missing_rule: Not extracted for review-only papers.
coding_rule: Preserve all existing IDs; later occasions retain the same sample identity.

definition: DOI of the included publication.
missing_rule: Missing if no DOI is established.
coding_rule: Normalise DOI URLs and missing placeholders; preserve identity registry.

definition: Title of the included publication.
missing_rule: Required.
coding_rule: Preserve the published title; record discrepancies in provenance.

definition: Abstract of the included publication.
missing_rule: Not reported if unavailable.
coding_rule: Retain original text and its source.

definition: Publication journal name.
missing_rule: Not reported if unavailable.
coding_rule: Record the journal of the included version.

definition: Complete ordered author list.
allowed_values: ordered author string preserved from source
missing_rule: Required when available.
coding_rule: Preserve author order and names; retain the original string.

definition: Abbreviated citation author label.
allowed_values: one author; Author & Author; Author et al.
missing_rule: Derive from verified authors where possible.
coding_rule: Generate consistently without parentheses; do not invent author names.

definition: Bibliographic year of the included version.
missing_rule: Not reported if unresolved.
coding_rule: Use the official citation year; log online-first versus issue-year discrepancies.

definition: Historical general eligibility field.
missing_rule: Do not invent a resolved decision for pending or uncertain records.
coding_rule: Preserve historical codes; define explicit mappings before exporting new records.

definition: Historical reason for quantitative exclusion.
missing_rule: Not applicable where no resolved mapping is available.
coding_rule: Import eligibility; do not reassess it during descriptive coding.

definition: Substantive review topics assigned using the current taxonomy.
allowed_values: Topic codes in topics_codebook; semicolon export
missing_rule: Unresolved codes enter an audit queue.
source: Complete full text and topic codebook
coding_rule: Normalise exact approved aliases; retain old coding/version for future AI recoding.

definition: Resolved legacy route derived from full-text eligibility.
missing_rule: Blank while eligibility is unresolved.
coding_rule: Never enter manually or convert pending data retrieval into exclusion.

definition: Corresponding-author email addresses reported by the source.
missing_rule: Not reported if unavailable; do not infer addresses.
coding_rule: Recording an address does not authorise sending a message.

definition: Locations of relevant datasets and data resources.
missing_rule: Differentiate not reported from access not yet verified.
coding_rule: Record access status in provenance; a URL alone does not establish availability.

definition: Design of the eligible component.
missing_rule: Not extracted for review-only papers.
coding_rule: Keep long for longitudinal studies even when only the first eligible occasion is used.

definition: Countries of the participants.
allowed_values: country names; mixed in legacy export
missing_rule: Unknown if participant country is not reported.
coding_rule: Do not infer from author affiliation; preserve identified historical inferences for audit.

definition: Reported percentage of female/women participants.
missing_rule: Not reported when unavailable or denominator is unclear.
coding_rule: Preserve source sex/gender terminology and denominator; describe additional categories in notes.

definition: Reported mean age in years of the pertinent sample.
missing_rule: Not reported when only median/range is available; retain these in notes.
coding_rule: Keep original precision; do not manufacture a mean from ranges or medians.

definition: Reference analytic sample size after relevant exclusions.
missing_rule: Not reported if the analytic size cannot be established.
coding_rule: A single analytic N is retained even when correlations have different N; describe differences and known range in notes.

definition: Broad descriptive age group of the studied population.
missing_rule: Unknown when insufficient information; document mixed composition.
coding_rule: Preschool children; school-age children/adolescents; young adults roughly 18-29; heterogeneous adult samples use adult; selected older samples roughly 65+. Do not classify from mean alone.

definition: Clinical population description, separate from eligibility.
missing_rule: Unknown when the source does not establish status.
coding_rule: Describe mixed populations in clinical_spec/notes; do not infer severity from a diagnosis alone.

definition: Clinical conditions and diagnostic or screening basis.
missing_rule: Not applicable for established non-clinical samples.
coding_rule: Preserve the authors' description and distinguish diagnosis from symptom screening.

definition: SEB/BESSI instrument, version and informant actually used.
missing_rule: Not reported when unresolved; no demographic/measurement extraction for review-only.
coding_rule: Associate instruments with the eligible component; preserve multiple measures distinctly.

definition: Classification of the instrument form.
missing_rule: Unknown for unclassified forms.
coding_rule: Use a maintained form mapping; do not infer long/short from an arbitrary item-count threshold.

definition: Personality-trait framework assessed in the eligible sample.
allowed_values: bf;hexaco; legacy seb requires source verification
missing_rule: Not applicable when no trait measure is used.
coding_rule: Keep historical seb entries until verified; do not treat SEB measurement as a personality framework by default.

definition: Identity of the extractor or verifier.
allowed_values: documented human ID or ai with provenance
missing_rule: Required for new coding; retain legacy identity.
coding_rule: Distinguish AI extraction, human verification and legacy import; record model only when known.

definition: Scientific interpretation and coding notes linked to the pertinent unit.
missing_rule: Blank when no note is needed.
coding_rule: Record variable correlation N, mixed ages, occasion used, overlap and meaningful ambiguities; retain page/table evidence separately.

definition: Historical compatibility column without an established substantive definition.
missing_rule: Blank for new records unless its purpose is explicitly agreed.
coding_rule: Keep existing contents; add future structured information as versioned fields instead of an undefined catch-all.
